searchText: MSRP $133,826. New 2026 Thor Chateau® 21Z. It measures approximately 24 feet 1 inches in length providing a sleeping, dining and living space while still remaining compact enough for most any state park and exceptional maneuverability even for first time RVers! This features the Ford E-Series Chassis and the Ford 7.3L V8. 325HP engine with 450 lb.-ft Torque. Optional features include 50 state California compliant gas/lp generator. Additional features and construction highlights include an Thor’s MEGA-Storage® exterior compartment, One-piece fiberglass front cap, one-piece upper rear cap, premium one-piece crossflex exterior roofing, power patio awning with integrated LED lighting, Drop down stairwell entrance step with accent light under step, exterior grab handle, 7” Touchscreen dash radio with Bluetooth, Android Auto, Apple CarPlay, keyless entry key fob, back-up monitor, full extension soft close metal ball-bearing drawer guides, cab-over sleeping area with cup holders and bunk ladder, dual child safety tethers in dinette, flip-up countertop extension, automatic transfer switch with power protection, tankless water heater and battery tray for four batteries.
